title: Simulation-module interpretability object
description:
The per-run object the simulation module emits for the orchestrator's side panel. It is UNIQUE to this module: a 'reasoning trace' here is the WORKFLOW trace — which stages ran, the intermediate scores, their provenance and caveats — never LLM chain-of-thought. It is carried at output.interpretability in the run's output file (see output.schema.json), so a consumer reads exactly one file. A sibling module emits a differently-shaped object against its own copy of this schema; the side panel keys rendering off `module` and the `display`/`placement` hints each section carries, so it needs no per-module rendering code.

GLOBAL DISPLAY HEURISTIC (top to bottom; the renderer follows the per-section hints, this is the frame):
  1. HEADLINE — full width, top, largest type. `verdict` renders as a colour chip: green=small_molecule_tractable, red=not_tractable, grey=insufficient_evidence. `one_line` sits beside/under it.
  2. FIGURE — if `figure.kind != "none"`, it shares the TOP ROW to the RIGHT of the headline text (headline ~60% left, figure ~40% right). On a panel narrower than ~640px the figure wraps to full width directly BELOW the headline. If absent or kind==none, the headline spans full width. `figure.path` resolves RELATIVE TO THE OUTPUT FILE'S DIRECTORY; if the file is missing, render `caption`/`alt` as a text placeholder rather than breaking.
  3. BANNER — if present, a full-width strip immediately under the headline/figure row, coloured by `level`; NOT collapsible. This is where predicted-structure warnings and an axis_conflict surface. Always visible.
  4. AXES — the two axes render as TWO COLUMNS SIDE BY SIDE (retrieved_precedent left, computed_tractability right) and are NEVER merged into one score. Each column shows its status pill, one headline_number, then rows. A row whose `caveat` is non-null MUST render the caveat inline (a smaller subline under the value or a persistent tag) — never hide a caveat behind hover-only. A within-structure score is pre-formatted in `value` as 'rank k of n in <pdb>'.
  5. TRACE — a vertical stack of DROPDOWNS (collapsible), one per stage, ordered by `order`. Each opens/closes per its own `display` hint; convention is that the stage carrying the verdict basis is `open` and the rest `collapsed`. Expanding shows the stage `fields`, and the stage `figure` (if any) ABOVE its fields.
  6. NOT_FOUND — a muted dropdown, collapsed by default, titled 'Not retrieved'; lists field + verbatim reason. It exists to make null != zero visible.
  7. PROVENANCE — a footer: as_of_date and the source list.

HARD RENDERING RULES: never merge the two axes into a single number; never render a null as 0 (show '—' or the not_found reason); a critical caveat renders inline, not hover-only.

module.description: Module identity, so the panel can label the tab and pick module-specific affordances. Always "simulation" for this module.

headline.description: Rendered first, full width, top. The one thing a reader sees before expanding anything.

verdict_label.description: Human label for the chip, e.g. 'Small-molecule tractable'.

one_line.description: A single honest sentence a non-specialist can read.

figure.description: OPTIONAL. When present and kind != 'none', it occupies the RIGHT of the top row beside the headline (see heuristic §2). Omit it, or set kind:'none', when there is nothing to show — a structure-less predicted run may still carry a model render; a purely precedent-carried verdict often has no figure.

path.description: Path to a PNG/SVG, RELATIVE TO THE OUTPUT FILE'S DIRECTORY. Null when kind=='none'.

caption.description: Rendered under the figure, and used as the text placeholder if the file is missing.

placement.description: Requested placement; the renderer may override to below_headline on a narrow panel.

banner.description: OPTIONAL full-width strip under the headline row; not collapsible. Carries predicted-structure warnings, an axis_conflict, or a data-quality note that must not be hidden.

axes.description: EXACTLY two entries — retrieved_precedent then computed_tractability — rendered as two side-by-side columns, never merged. This mirrors the dossier's two-axis architecture: the two are reported separately and no overall number is computed.

status.description: Rendered as a pill at the column head.

value.description: Pre-formatted for display; a within-structure score is written as 'rank k of n in <pdb>'.

caveat.description: If non-null, MUST render inline beneath the value.

trace.description: The workflow stages in execution order, each rendered as a collapsible dropdown. This is the literal 'reasoning trace' the panel exposes on a click: the pipeline's steps and what each computed.

stage.description: e.g. graph-intake, structure-select, pocket-scan, precedent-lookup, falsification, assemble-dossier.

summary.description: One line shown on the collapsed dropdown header.

display.description: Default dropdown state. Open the stage that carried the verdict basis; collapse the rest.

fields.description: Intermediate scores shown when the dropdown expands.

figure.description: OPTIONAL per-stage image, rendered ABOVE the stage's fields when the dropdown is open. Same relative-path and missing-file rules as the top-level figure.

not_found.description: Rendered as a muted, collapsed dropdown titled 'Not retrieved'. Each entry is a field that could not be retrieved plus the verbatim reason — the panel's proof that a null is not a zero.
